name: coolify-cloudflare-cache-purge
description: A multi-zone Cloudflare Worker that purges application caches after successful Coolify deployments.

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run deploy:dry-run

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: A Cloudflare API token with Zone Read and Cache Purge permissions, scoped to every zone this Worker may manage.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: A random secret of at least 32 characters. Add it to the Coolify webhook URL as the token query parameter.

PURGE_MODE.description: Use hostname (recommended) to purge only deployed hostnames, or everything to purge every matched zone.
